title: Game of Tag
text: “Waaah!”
“What, what happened?”
“What’s wrong?”
Father caught Wolf head-on as it lunged. Wolf had sunk its teeth into Father’s shoulder.
“Gah… it’s lost control of itself! Motoyasu-kun! Put Wolf to sleep to calm it down!”
Now that was a specific instruction, I say.
“Understood! Then it’s Sleep Lance V!”
“Kyaiin!?”
Just as Wolf thrashed and lunged at Father, I put it to sleep instantly with a Sleep Lance imbued with a sleep effect. Wolf went limp, eyes rolled back, and slumped over.
“Hmm…”
“Um, does whipping usually cause that much pain?”
“No, that’s excessive, even for whipping.”
The rabbit man and the mixed-breed lizardman muttered under their breath as if the words had just slipped out.
“Ah… this must be fear conditioned from the whipping. If it’s just me, I can stop Wolf’s attacks, but… making that into a show act might be difficult.”
Father gently stroked Wolf, who lay there with its eyes still rolled back.
“This is, well… I think having them perform a duel routine would be good. Wolf’s a battle-damaged slave so its movements have issues, but Motoyasu-kun, could you spar with Wolf?”
“Leave it to me, I say.”
And so it was decided that we’d run a program where Wolf and I fought, with me winning in the end.
“But… I see, so I suppose the idea is to act pained the way Wolf did?”
“That’d also be overdoing the pain, so no… it’s a tricky balance, but please give it your best.”

Father gave the order carefully, mindful of his tone so he wouldn’t be underestimated. The rabbit man and the mixed-breed lizardman nodded with complicated expressions. After a while, Wolf woke up. It glanced around, looking here and there, and after turning its face toward Father…
“Kuun.”
It let out a sound as if apologizing and drew closer.
“You don’t… recognize me as the enemy who did something awful to you?”
“Wau.”
Wolf made a sound while staring intently at the whip. Father stroked it, saying sorry for doing something unpleasant, and Wolf narrowed its eyes as if it felt good.
“Still, it’d be a problem if you went wild during acting practice. Wolf, sorry about that.”
“Bau!”
It didn’t seem to be bothered by it at all, apparently.
“Wolf… you’re in the act where you fight Motoyasu-kun. The other Filolials could do it too, but the balance is tricky, so practice.”
“Kuun…”
Somehow Wolf wore an expression as if it regretted missing out on Father’s whipping performance.
“Wolf, I do intend to use you as a spectacle, but I have no intention of doing anything I truly hate to you. Understand?”
“Ku… kuun.”
Did it want to be whipped, perhaps?
“It wants Father to whip it, I say! I agree completely, indeed!”
I whipped off my clothes and bared my back, demanding to be whipped too! Yeah!

The rabbit man and the mixed-breed lizardman seemed to be giving me strange looks, but that must’ve just been my imagination. You two are whip-comrades too, I say! Savor the pleasant sensation of a caressing whip!
“No, that’s probably not it. And don’t take your clothes off again.”
Father shot me down. Even so, Wolf apparently began to occasionally request whipping from Father while still feeling fear of it.
“Can’t be helped. Wolf… bite here on the whip, and I’ll get on your back.”
“Bau?”
Father had Wolf clamp the whip in its mouth and climbed onto its back.
“Go!”
“Bau bau!”
Wolf carried Father and dashed off. It looked incredibly fun. Despite the lingering awkwardness from old injuries in its arms and legs, it ran as if bounding through the air.
“Wow! That looks fun!”
“Tag, tag! Let us join, let us join!”
“Dark Gale Wolf Fang, go! Yaaay!”
The Filolial-samas happily chased after Father and Wolf’s joyride.
“Piyo! Piyo!”
Yuki-chan watched the scene with eyes sparkling. As expected of Yuki-chan. That racing spectacle got her blood pumping.
“I’m coming too, I say! Drive Mode, engage!”
“Whoa!?”
“Hiii!?”
Gyururururun! Indeed! The rabbit man and the mixed-breed lizardman let out cries. Whatever was the matter with them?
“Ha ha ha… bau bau!”
Wolf was carrying Father along, letting out cheerful cries as it ran, so I joined the Filolial-samas in giving chase. Then Wolf suddenly turned to look back at me—and did a double take.
“Kyain kyain kyain!?”
“Whoa!? What’s wrong— hii!?”
It tried to bolt away from the spot without so much as a sideways glance. Whatever was going on? Father too looked over at me and let out a startled cry.
“Kyaun!”
And then, failing its leap and about to spin out of control, Wolf instinctively wrapped itself around Father to shield him. Zazazaaa! Father and Wolf went tumbling. A cloud of dust kicked up.
“You okay?”
“Does it hurt?”
“Kitaa~ if there’s an injury you should heal it right away!”
“Indeed. Father, are you alright?”
I rushed over to Father and the others, deactivating Drive Mode.
“I’m fine, but… Wolf, are you okay?”
Wolf pushed itself up, then abruptly leapt and took a stance facing me for some reason.
“Bau! Uuuuu!”
Its arm was scraped up. Father rushed over to examine the arm.
“Needs treatment… Wolf, calm down.”
“Bau… kuun.”
Pinned down by Father, Wolf settled down. So I got right to treating it.
“I just can’t seem to keep it in a good mood… sorry about that, Wolf.”
“Kuun.”
Wolf licked at Father’s hand affectionately. I’d like to lick that hand too, honestly. In fact, if Father ever turned into a peckul, I’d love to nuzzle that enchanting belly of his.
“By the way, wasn’t Motoyasu-kun just now turned into some kind of human motorbike from a certain famous manga…?”
Father turned to face the Siltvelt envoy, the rabbit man, and the mixed-breed lizardman, and they all averted their gazes.
“Drive Mode, indeed.”
“No, don’t look so proud of it… who taught you to run like that anyway?”
“Motoyasu came up with it in a flash of inspiration to catch up with Filo-tan, I say.”

“An original move, huh… I feel like I understand a bunch of things now. It’s a bit too much stimulation, so Motoyasu-kun, using Drive Mode requires permission from now on. Just run normally and play with the Filolials. You’re fast on your feet as it is.”
“Awww, I say.”
So now even my dream rendezvous with Filo-tan required permission. Nothing to be done about it. I’ll use Second Mode only when necessary.

“Well, once you’ve built up a reputation to some extent, it’ll be fine to use it, but hitting people with that much stimulation all at once is too much. You have to build up the excitement gradually or the audience gets bored of it.”
So sudden stimulation gets a circus audience bored, does it? Understood.
“Anyway… we got a bit sidetracked, but Théodore and Sion, you two practice acting pained. Got it?”
“Y-yes.”
“Understood… but I have now grasped my master’s particular… inclinations.”
The mixed-breed lizardman really did have a stiff way of speaking. From then on, the two of them each began practicing acting pained. And so the carriage continued on its way.
“It’s a carnival!”
“It’s a dance of darkness!”
“We’ve arrived!”
“Mostomoto! Is here fine?”
The Filolial-samas reported that we had arrived at the planned location. They let out very cheerful cries.
“Théo, lie there until treatment’s done. Wolf, you can come along but don’t go wild. Sion, help unload the cargo.”
Father, who had been giving the rabbit man another round of moxibustion and acupuncture treatment, climbed down from the carriage and gave out instructions.
“Yes.”
“Bau!”
“Understood.”
Father climbed down from the carriage, issuing orders to each of his three slaves, and set about erecting the show circus tent in the plaza of the planned town, indeed.
